review.reviewNotes: Four distinct complete Nova Stitch block poses preserve her high teal ponytail, human face, athletic proportions and teal/purple uniform. Takeoff at frame1/tick2, two-hand jump block peaks at frame2/tick5, then controlled landing at frame3/tick8.
